substrate.silica_model: Malitson fused silica; approximate thermal oxide

optical_constants.convention: positive imaginary index for exp(-i omega t)
optical_constants.regime: published constant-index approximation; no measured local material calibration
optical_constants.layer_spacing_status: conventional structural spacing; not an AFM apparent height

silicon_data.transcription: Existing hash-pinned Aspnes silicon table; CC0 refractiveindex.info transcription

caveats: Oxide thickness is provisional until the actual graphene/hBN wafer is specified.
Spectral weights must describe illumination times camera response; white balance alone is insufficient.
Raw linear unclipped dark-corrected contrast is required for quantitative comparison.
Optical constants are published approximations, not monolayer-specific measured constants.
Finite-NA isotropic extension neglects tensor anisotropy and imaging diffraction/defocus.
Water, residue, gaps and other transparent films can overlap material contrast.
Physical thickness and layer number remain conditional; obtain Raman/AFM or confirmed local reference labels.
